title: Hospital Visitor and Attender Management Policy
rules: Only one designated primary attender badge issued per admitted inpatient.
Visiting hours in General Ward strictly restricted to 16:30 - 18:30 IST daily.
ICU visiting permitted only for 10 minutes between 11:00 - 12:00 IST and 17:00 - 18:00 IST with PPE compliance.
Children under the age of 12 are strictly prohibited from entering clinical inpatient areas.
exceptions: Terminal illness or end-of-life pastoral visits authorized by Medical Superintendent.
Bilingual attender companion permitted for pediatric and elderly patients.
